title: Enterprise AI Canvas: Integrating Artificial Intelligence into Business
extended_summary:
This paper proposes the Enterprise AI Canvas, a structured framework for helping organizations evaluate and plan AI-based business opportunities. The author argues that integrating AI into business requires more than technical modeling: it also involves defining the value proposition, success metrics, decision logic, organizational changes, sponsorship, data sources, constraints, and monitoring processes.

The canvas is divided into two parts. Part 1 focuses on the business view, including value, success, decisions and optimization, organization, sponsor, and domains. Part 2 focuses on the model and data view, including prediction and action, features, data sources and processing, domains and data quality, constraints, and evaluation and monitoring. The framework is designed to bring business experts, domain experts, and data scientists together around a shared planning tool.

The paper does not study students or schools; instead, it illustrates the canvas with a supermarket replenishment example in an adult business context. In that example, AI is used to predict product demand and optimize ordering decisions. The main conclusion is that AI project planning should jointly consider business and technical issues from the outset, because prediction quality alone does not guarantee good operational outcomes.
quality_tier_rationale: This is a conceptual framework / design paper proposing the Enterprise AI Canvas for business use-cases. It does not present an empirical study, comparison, or measured educational intervention, so there is no research design to evaluate for causal credibility.
impact_tier_rationale: The paper has no direct educational or student outcome impact; it is a general business/AI planning framework. It provides a structured discussion tool rather than evidence of effect, so impact on the requested education topic is absent.
